recentItems.title: TYSON | Official Trailer | Netflix
recentItems.description:
TYSON is a raw four-part documentary that peels back the curtain on Mike Tyson’s explosive life, from a brutal Brooklyn childhood and a meteoric rise to heavyweight glory to the addiction, jail time, public breakdowns, and infamous ear bite that almost ended it all. Told unfiltered in Tyson’s own words, with never-before-seen material and rare access to his family, friends, and foes, it’s an intimate portrait of greatness, collapse, and a man still confronting the cost of his legacy.

recentItems.title: Fading Grandeur | Official Trailer | Netflix
recentItems.description:
Leandro (Antonio de la Torre) is a fallen marquis who will stop at nothing to regain his lost prestige. Obsessed with securing the title of ‘Grandee of Spain’ from the King, he must first survive a far harsher reality: keeping his lavish lifestyle and collapsing estate afloat.

When paying for his daughter’s wedding pushes him to the brink, Leandro puts his ancestral mansion on the market. Enter a prospective buyer. Winning her over becomes more than a game of romance, it’s his last desperate shot at salvation.

Set against a backdrop of titles, fortune, ambition, and illusions, Fading Grandeur follows a man determined to reclaim his place among the elite, no matter how far he has to push the envelope.

Antonio de la Torre leads the cast alongside Alexandra Jiménez and Mercedes Sampietro in this new series created and directed by Juan Cavestany and Álvaro Fernández Armero.

Fading Grandeur, arriving on October 23.

recentItems.title: The Storm | Official Trailer | Netflix
recentItems.description:
The Storm is a tense, character-driven dark comedy set during Filip’s 45th birthday dinner at a lavish newly purchased farm in northern Sweden. When a violent storm hits, trapping Filip and his closest friends inside, their polished facades quickly crumble, buried secrets surface, and raw emotions erupt as the gravity of the situation becomes impossible to ignore.
The Storm is written and directed by acclaimed filmmaker Josephine Bornebusch, produced by WBITVP Sweden and features a starstudded cast such as Gustaf Skarsgård, Aliette Opheim, Filip Berg, Josephine Bornebusch, Jonas Karlsson, Johan Rheborg, Christopher Wagelin, Sara Shirpey, Gizem Erdogan, Henrik Dorsin, Nils Wetterholm, and Nicole Levin.

The film is set to premiere globally on Netflix on October 15, 2026.
